items.q: Lonnie played the Famous Door with us, the Roseland, and the Apollo Theater.

ctx.x: He had another date or so to play with Lonnie Simmonds. us. So when Lonnie was there, we got (inaudible).
Lonnie played the Famous Door with us, the Roseland, and the Apollo Theater. And that the four weeks before we went back to the hotel in Boston.
Now if you ask me about that hotel in Boston, I don't know because we had played that hotel once before with Chick.
